notes: Two defensible judgment calls: PartOf (rather than the opaque Possession) for both "the lantern of the Harbor Station" and "its mire-essence", and Theme for the object of "struck" — the latter is explicitly covered by the instruction set's "when the test is unclear, default to Theme". Everything else — the Patient subject of the natural-force "returned", (Duration e briefly), the day-part Time, the stative-transitive Agent on "held", and the stayed-lit continuation-copular bundle (reified state + Still + Past + flat (Past (Member ... lit))) — follows the instruction set as written.
